target_customer: Security teams that need an inventory of cloud and on-prem assets and how they relate
problem: Security teams lack visibility into what assets they have and how they connect, which makes risk hard to reduce.
business_model: Open core, managed SaaS built around the Cartography open source project

founders.name: Kunaal Sikka
founders.background_notes: The two met at Lyft in 2020 per the YC page.

competitors.name: Wiz
competitors.what: Proprietary cloud security platform with a security graph
competitors.traction_then: Named by the founder as the closed counterpart to SubImage's open-core pitch

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting many cloud and SaaS sources into a graph is established engineering, built on the existing Cartography code the founders created.

defensibility.rationale: Ownership of the open source project and the integrations it contains give a head start, but the code is open and large vendors offer graphs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large cloud security vendors already sold graph based asset views. The sources do not show any of them copying or buying SubImage.

market_need_then: Security teams already use Cartography in production (the founder cites 70 plus companies on LinkedIn), which shows demand for asset graphs.

branding.name_origin: A third party profile says the name came out of a vulnerability management project at Lyft where the founders worked.
branding.brand_signature: Built by the creators of Cartography
branding.community_and_virality: The linked open source project Cartography was donated to the Linux Foundation and is used in production by many teams per the founder.

brand_strength.rationale: The founders' open source project gives credibility among security engineers, though the SubImage name itself has little press.

outcome_analysis: SubImage is active and raised a $4.2M seed in November 2025. Its founders created Cartography at Lyft, which gives distribution among security engineers, but it competes with well funded proprietary cloud security graphs. No later outcome is public.
notes: Press release dated 2025-11-17 confirms the seed, and Pulse 2 repeats it. A directory dates it October 2025 and ZoomInfo lists a separate $500K pre-seed, which is unverified and not recorded. Company website could not be fetched because the domain check was rate limited. The Wiz reference is from a 2025-11 article, not a source from the batch period. Name origin comes from a single third party profile. Alex Chantavy education not found. Outcome search found nothing relevant.
